title: Modern Ethiopian Injera Wrap
localName: ዘመናዊ እንጀራ ሲሙ — Modern Injera Wrap
author: Chef Haile
desc: Modern Ethiopian Injera Wrap — fresh injera rolled around berbere-seared meat (or spiced legumes for fasting), ayib, silsi, pickled vegetables, and fresh herbs. The injera-as-wrap format — the ancient bread repurposed as a contemporary street food delivery system.
longDesc: The modern injera wrap takes injera out of the mesob tradition and into the contemporary street food format — rolled around a filling, wrapped in paper, and eaten on the go. Ethiopian street food culture updated for the 21st century.
steps: Warm injera briefly in a dry pan — must be warm to roll.
Lay flat. Spread silsi across centre.
Layer shredded lettuce, tibs, ayib, pickled vegetables, jalapeños, coriander.
Wrap bottom half in paper or foil.
chefTips: Warm injera is essential for rolling.
cookingScience: See ETH183 for injera wrap flexibility science.
sustainabilityTips: Injera is gluten-free, teff-based, and far more nutritious than wheat wraps.
culturalNote: The modern injera wrap is the Ethiopian answer to the global street food wrap trend — the ancient bread that has been the plate, utensil, and food of Ethiopian civilization for thousands of years, now serving as a wrap. The injera wrap is the ancient and the modern in one hand.
